text:
nina-docs: Heads up — opened docs PR to rewrite the data deletion & retention section to match the new audit log schema and v2 SDKs. Also fixes a broken link to the python examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4321

omar-prod: thanks. can you summarize the changes? curious if we're changing any user-facing guarantees around deletion/retention.

nina-docs: summary: 1) replace v1 SDK snippets with v2 patterns 2) explain soft-delete vs final purge 3) add sample audit-log queries (elk/SQL) 4) correct link to sdk-python examples 5) updated retention wording to be SOC2-safe.

sarah-legal: quick note on wording — avoid absolutes about backups. Suggest: "We make commercially reasonable efforts to remove data from active systems and from backups in accordance with our retention schedules; residual copies may persist for a limited period." Also add: "Data subject to legal or regulatory holds will be retained as required."

nina-docs: would you prefer we keep the 'limited period' vague or include a max number (e.g., 90 days)?

sarah-legal: keep it vague for public docs. If a customer asks for a retention SLA we can refer to contract/enterprise addendum.

tim-sdk: I updated the Python snippet in my branch. Old: `client.delete('/api/v1/object/123')` New v2: `client.objects.delete('123')`. For node, `await client.objects.delete('123')`. Also changed curl examples to /v2 paths and fixed the example link to https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/tree/main/examples/delete. I'll open SDK PR after docs review (PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/pull/129).

felix-sre: one more ops detail — when we soft-delete an object we set two fields in the audit event: `deletion_state: "soft"` and `bg_purge_eta: "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z"` (example). Docs should show that audit events may include a purge ETA but not promise it.

nina-docs: good point. i'll include an example audit event with both fields. sample: ```json
{
  "event": "object.delete",
  "actor": "user:alice@example.com",
  "object_id": "obj-789",
  "deletion_state": "soft",
  "bg_purge_eta": "2026-01-15T00:00:00Z",
  "ts": "2025-11-05T09:12:00Z"
}
```

omar-prod: also add a sample query for the audit log store: `SELECT * FROM audit_events WHERE event = 'object.delete' AND ts > '2025-01-01' ORDER BY ts DESC LIMIT 50;` That helps SREs and customers debugging retention flows.

sarah-legal: and add a short blurb about legal holds: "If Redwood receives a valid legal process requiring retention, we will preserve the specified records and notify the customer unless legally prohibited."

tim-sdk: small note on console UX — after soft-delete the Console shows items under an "Archived" tab for 30 days; after background purge they disappear. Docs should avoid exact timing unless product signs off.

nina-docs: i'll phrase it as: "The Console shows recently removed items in an 'Archived' view for a short period before they're excluded from queries." keeps it safe.

felix-sre: CI: deploying example link fix to staging docs search index now.

ci-bot: Docs PR #4321 — checks: link-checker failed for one internal anchor (line 142). Broken link flagged.

nina-docs: ack, will fix the anchor. Also will add a note linking to SDK PR 129 once it's merged. Planning to push the edits in next hour and request final review.

sarah-legal: lgtm on the phrasing approach once you remove absolute timelines.

tim-sdk: i'll coordinate a small SDK doc update after the docs merge so the examples align.

nina-docs: thanks all — will update and request final review shortly. If no objections i'll merge by EOD. :thumbsup:
